name: Year of the Ladybug: Season 1
source:
In 'Year of the Ladybug: Season 1,' characters traverse a nightmarish realm filled with fear and despair, revealing sinister secrets while evading the relentless terrors that pursue them at every turn.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325130/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在《瓢虫之年：第一季》中，角色们穿越一个充满恐惧和绝望的噩梦般的国度，揭露险恶的秘密，同时躲避每时每刻追赶他们的无情恐怖。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325130/]Steam[/url]]
